item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description:
• The panel follows macOS: Liquid Glass, a Spotlight-size search field, and selection like macOS menus.
  • Hover a row for Pin and Delete; the plain-text button is gone (⇧Return and the right-click menu still do it).

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
• Ignore these apps: an editable list, pre-filled with password managers.
  • Delete items older than 1, 7, 30 or 90 days (pinned items are kept).
  • Settings shows the Paste from Other Apps permission and backs off when it's denied.
  • Choose whether picking an item pastes it or only copies it.
  • ⌘1–⌘9 paste the first nine items in the panel.

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
• The history panel resizes from its edges and corners and keeps its size.
  • Drag it by its top edge and it reopens there.
  • Copies marked auto-generated, and older password-manager markers, are never recorded.
  • Stable order for copies made in the same instant.

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description: • A gear button in the panel opens Settings, and has Pause Capture, Clear History and Quit.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
• HANDOFF: state after the first merge
  • Merge app (claude/app-a1ed68)
  • Merge release pipeline (claude/release-c3e54e)
  • HANDOFF: where the Sparkle key is backed up
  • Watcher: drop a copy that changed while being read; store removes files after commit; bounded thumbnails; URL-only copies
  • Delete goes through the capture writer: a pending duplicate capture no longer brings a deleted item back
  • Panel: short relative time
  • Start Sparkle at launch; Check for Updates in the status menu and Settings
  • release.sh: feed items only for universal binaries, clean feed clone, no manual publish path
  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/claude/release-c3e54e' into claude/app-a1ed68
  • Store: file writes and removals inside the database write; image cap keeps older pins
  • Order captures against Clear History; credit copies to a password manager seen since the last poll
  • release.sh: publish universal builds only
  • Paste bump keeps the user's history limit; drop unused panel hint
  • release.sh: refuse to publish unnotarized, stage the appcast in printed commands
  • App: --show-panel launch flag for QA captures
  • App: menu bar item, hotkey, floating panel, paste, settings, dev run script
  • release.sh: publish only from a clean tree, push source before uploads
  • Core: ClipItem, GRDB history store with FTS5, pasteboard reader, secret rules
  • Release pipeline: package, release, Sparkle embed and updater, icon, docs
  • Skeleton: SwiftPM package, docs, Info.plist, release placeholders
